# OrcaMatrix / aPaaS AI Workspace

This repository is an open-source aggregation of the OrcaMatrix / aPaaS AI workspace. It contains product design material, platform services, frontend console code, runtime tooling, generated app seed code, and integration examples.

## Modules

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `product-design/` | Product specs, design sources, prototypes, and cross-module handoff documents. |
| `agentic-coding/` | Agentic coding toolchain, CLI wrappers, skills, runtime evidence helpers, and tests. |
| `agent-runtime/` | Sandbox runtime, workspace/session orchestration, runtime web UI, and runtime contracts. |
| `app-seed/` | Generated application seed runtime, SDK integration baseline, frontend template, DB scripts, and deploy assets. |
| `approve-engine/` | Approval workflow engine modules and Flowable integration. |
| `control-plane/` | Platform control plane backend, API contracts, adapters, and deployment scripts. |
| `web-console/` | React-based platform console frontend. |
| `platform-integration/` | DevOps and integration baseline for GitLab, registry, observability, Helm, and E2E examples. |
| `agent-build-ai/` | AI Builder application, backend, frontend, desktop sidecar, and deployment assets. |

## Security And Configuration

Real credentials, local environment files, run logs, generated evidence, private network exports, and machine-specific tool state are intentionally excluded. Use the checked-in `.env.example` files and replace `example.com` placeholders with your own deployment values.

Before publishing a fork or pushing to a public remote, run a fresh secret scan and rotate any credential that may have existed in local files before this cleanup.

## Development

Each module keeps its own build and test commands in its local `README.md` and `AGENTS.md`. This root repository is intentionally a source aggregation; run module-specific commands from the module directory.

No build was run as part of the open-source cleanup.
